findings.title: Compute the queued timestamp for each AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value carries the worker process startup time rather than the time the assignment was queued. This stale value is serialized into every outbound task, making the provenance timestamp incorrect and unusable for ordering or age-based handling. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to create a timestamp per instance.
